projects.title: Luxury Recipe Finder
projects.summary: Premium recipe discovery platform with curated collections and smart search.
projects.problem: Home cooks wanted a refined way to discover high-quality recipes without cluttered ads and noisy interfaces.
projects.approach: Built a Laravel API with React frontend, focusing on clean search, curated collections, and a calm reading experience for recipes.
projects.result: A polished full-stack product demonstrating API design, relational data modeling, and modern frontend architecture.
highlights: Smart search with filters and collections

projects.title: Nexus — Personal Finance
projects.summary: Personal finance platform with biometric WebAuthn login, budgets, AI coaching, and admin dashboards.
projects.problem: Financial apps rely on passwords that are weak for sensitive data, while most trackers lack budgets, insights, and a polished experience.
projects.approach: Built a Laravel API with Laragear WebAuthn for passwordless fingerprint/face login, plus a React + TypeScript frontend featuring dashboards, budget alerts, transaction management, multi-currency support, and an AI finance coach.
projects.result: A secure, production-style finance product combining modern passkey authentication, email OTP verification, role-based admin tools, and rich data visualizations.
highlights: Budgets with limit-check jobs and transaction receipts
AI chatbot finance coach + analytics charts (Recharts)
Admin dashboard with roles and email OTP verification

projects.title: Mise en Box
projects.summary: Weekly meal-kit e-commerce platform with recipes, planner, cart, and a luxury dark mode.
projects.problem: Meal-kit customers juggle recipes, shopping lists, and pantry stock across disconnected sites, with no single place to plan the week or check out.
projects.approach: Built a React 19 + TypeScript SPA with Vite and React Router covering recipe discovery, weekly meal planner, gift boxes, pantry stock, and a slide-out cart backed by context state.
projects.result: A polished, fully responsive storefront demonstrating SPA architecture, state management, and premium dark-mode UI design.
highlights: Recipe catalog with detail pages and curated collections
Weekly meal planner and cart drawer with context state
Product, pantry, gift box, and app-download pages
Luxury dark theme with responsive mobile nav

projects.title: Vellum — Smart Recipe & AI Culinary Assistant
projects.summary: Bachelor's capstone: a full kitchen-management platform with AI chef assistant, smart pantry, budget planning, and admin command center.
projects.problem: Home cooks juggle recipes, pantry stock, meal plans, and grocery budgets across disconnected tools — with no intelligent help when deciding what to cook.
projects.approach: Built a React + Vite frontend and Laravel 11 REST API with MySQL, integrating the Google Gemini API for ChefBot (AI cooking assistant), plus smart pantry suggestions, multi-currency budget planning, analytics charts, role-based admin moderation, and Sanctum token auth.
projects.result: A comprehensive, production-style full-stack application deployed live, covering community recipe moderation, AI integration, analytics, and secure authentication end-to-end.
highlights: ChefBot AI assistant powered by Google Gemini API
Smart pantry with recipe suggestions from stock
Shopping list with multi-currency budget planner
Admin command center: user roles, recipe moderation, analytics
Laravel Sanctum token auth + community recipe approval flow
